rationale: The agent verified identity using full name and zip code, matched to a single user ID, and only acted on that user’s orders. They retrieved the relevant delivered order and confirmed item details via tools. They presented accurate, available exchange options based on product data. Before making any changes, the agent requested explicit confirmation for both items; when the user limited the exchange to the desk lamp only, the agent reconfirmed that narrower action and proceeded accordingly. The exchange was executed after confirmation with the correct item IDs, and the communicated price difference ($5.08) matches the tool result and item prices. The agent provided correct final information about payment processing and return instructions. No unsupported claims or policy violations were observed.
